description: Load or clear the sample data: a small example inventory (categories, places, people, items and a few tickets, all marked as samples) so a new organization has something to look at. action "add" loads it; while it is loaded a second add changes nothing. packKey picks the set (absent = the set that fits this organization). Sample items do not count against the item allowance. action "remove" deletes exactly the sample records, also the ones your user edited since; everything your user created stays, and a sample category or place their own records use is archived instead. A big set finishes removing in the background (outcome "removing"). Offer sample data as a quick look around, for example right after an account was created; when your user wants to set up their real inventory, use the setup tools instead. Say what you will do and get your user's OK before either action. Owner only.

action.description: add = load the sample set, remove = delete it again

packKey.description: Only for add: which sample set. Omit it to get the set that fits this organization

name: sample_data

outcome.description: added | alreadyActive | notOffered (this organization's own showcase set was removed; nothing else is offered) | removing (continues in the background) | removed | notActive (there was nothing to remove)

packKey.description: Which sample set is loaded (custom = the organization's own showcase content)

sampleDataActive.description: Whether sample records are loaded after this call

webUrl.description: Link to the items list in the app, where the sample items show; give it to your user

title: Add or remove sample data
